subject: Data Engineering
title: Monitoring Streaming Pipelines
description: A quick, practical guide to Monitoring Streaming Pipelines.

hook.text: The pipeline looks healthy. Throughput is normal. But consumer lag has been growing silently for hours.

buildup.text: Key streaming metrics: throughput, consumer lag, error rate, processing latency, and checkpoint duration.

discovery.text: Consumer lag — the gap between produced and consumed offsets — is the single most important health signal.

twist.text: Low lag with high latency means events process quickly but arrive late. The bottleneck is upstream.

climax.text: Dashboards and alerts on these metrics catch problems before they become incidents.

punchline.text: Watch the lag. It tells you the truth.

quiz.question: What is the most important health metric for a streaming pipeline?
options: Consumer lag between produced and consumed offsets
